verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair axis for an auth service, but the evidence pack never documents one for Supabase Auth: no test mode, local emulator, branching, or isolated non-production project. The pack covers only RLS scoping, auth hooks, MFA, SSO and anonymous sign-ins, which are adjacent features and not sandbox isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
